#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
source .dev-env
export DEPENDENCY_SOURCE_DIGEST=75f8350-prototype
export PORT_SOURCE_DIGEST=full13-canonical-cache-prototype
export CARGO_CRATE_NAME=symbolica_amflow
taskset -c 31 rustc --edition=2024 -C opt-level=2 target/fivepoint-canonical-cache/main.rs -o target/fivepoint-canonical-cache/probe \
 --extern symbolica_amflow=target/algebraic-engine/deps/libsymbolica_amflow.rlib \
 --extern symbolica=target/release/deps/libsymbolica-75e897282e2131a2.rlib \
 --extern ahash=target/release/deps/libahash-83e25d37cc3da50b.rlib \
 --extern linnet=target/release/deps/liblinnet-207fb9ba6bc15b59.rlib \
 --extern serde=target/release/deps/libserde-56ff5551063f771d.rlib \
 --extern serde_json=target/release/deps/libserde_json-c589b03db684a851.rlib \
 --extern bincode=target/release/deps/libbincode-4f2a26f82e3926ba.rlib \
 --extern blake3=target/release/deps/libblake3-16d30a88cd388891.rlib \
 -L dependency=target/release/deps

boundary_precision_policy.note: Conservative allowance from132-digit source absolute-accuracy metadata. Finite-accuracy zeros are not exact; preserve source metadata in prepared-input.json. This is supplied reference boundary, not analytic construction.
